# `scikitplot.mcp`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

Composable documentation retrieval for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
pip install scikit-plots-mcp  # this part only
```

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it:

```sh
python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"
python -c "import scikitplot.mcp as m, inspect; print(inspect.signature(m.<name>)); help(m.<name>)"
```

## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.mcp.server_capabilities`)

```pycon
>>> caps = server_capabilities()
>>> caps["kind"], caps["effect_class"]
('static', 'read_only')
>>> [t["name"] for t in caps["tools"]]
['search_docs']
```
